purpose: Test a learned connection from the visual target heatmap into the recurrent driving policy
targetQuality: heuristic projection, color pixels and detector component, not proven instance segmentation
baseline: matched target-heatmap-v1 heatmap-supervised model without an actor connection
treatment: same actor and heatmap initialization, labels, data and shuffle; a 400-to-128 projection of the visual heatmap is added to recurrent features, initially zero
evaluation: Canonical eight-case screen; paired full32 if either matched checkpoint returns in both room types
